idle.behavior: 缓慢呼吸，头部自然偏转，目光短暂保持，再缓缓回正

observing.behavior: 目光先向侧方追踪，头部稍迟跟随，保持观察约1秒

curious.behavior: 轻轻歪头、好奇注视，保留明显停顿，不动肩部

focused.behavior: 轻低头、稳定视线凝视，维持专注姿态

concerned.behavior: 头部缓慢下沉，忧虑凝视和慢眨眼，保持担忧姿势

relieved.behavior: 缓缓抬头，眼神放松，微弱笑意停留后消退

technique: Original bitmap with frame-by-frame localized pixel deformation; no torso redraw
note: Animated GIF supports binary, not partial alpha. Transparent background and opaque black hair are preserved.
